issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 02 returns an extra column (Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel) that is not requested by the problem statement. The instructions explicitly say "Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr." Returning the additional gemeindeschluessel column creates a mismatch between the problem specification and the provided solution, which can confuse students and cause automated checks to fail if they expect exactly the requested columns.
issues.suggestedFix:
Modify the solution for aufgabe02.sql to select only the requested columns (Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, Gemeinde.name) and include the join condition. For example:
SELECT Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, Gemeinde.name
FROM Freizeitpark, Gemeinde
WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel
This removes the unnecessary Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel column and aligns the solution with the problem instruction to return exactly the requested data.
